title: Polynomial equals biased minus probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The biased minus-probability polynomial of $f$ at $p$ equals the probability that $f$ takes the value $-1$ under the product distribution with the corresponding bias.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
